title: The Claude Skills Starter Kit: 10 Skills to Install Today, and Ideas for Every Role
summary: Ten ready-made Claude skills to download, how to install and use them in Claude and Claude Code, skills worth having for twenty roles, and how to make and check your own.

downloads.name: claude-skills-starter-kit.zip
downloads.title: All ten skills
downloads.about: For Claude Code: unzip it into ~/.claude/skills/. In the Claude apps, upload the skills one at a time.

downloads.title: learn-anything
downloads.about: A patient tutor: a short plan, one idea at a time, and a check after each.

downloads.title: quiz-me
downloads.about: Practice questions from your notes, one at a time, with every answer explained.

downloads.title: research-brief
downloads.about: A one-page, sourced brief with a confidence level for each finding.

downloads.title: news-explainer
downloads.about: AI and tech news, explained plainly, with every claim attributed.

downloads.title: linkedin-post
downloads.about: LinkedIn posts in your own voice, with an opening worth reading.

downloads.title: job-application
downloads.about: Your CV and cover letter tailored to a job ad, honestly.

downloads.title: meeting-to-actions
downloads.about: Decisions, actions with owners and dates, and a follow-up email.

downloads.title: presentation-planner
downloads.about: The story, slide by slide, with titles that make the point and speaker notes.

downloads.title: check-the-numbers
downloads.about: Data answers proved first, with a script that profiles each file.

downloads.title: skill-maker
downloads.about: Makes, checks and packages a new skill with you. Includes the template.

downloads.name: SKILL-template.md
downloads.title: SKILL.md template
downloads.about: A blank skill to fill in: frontmatter, steps, rules, example and checklist.

downloads.title: Cheat sheet
downloads.about: One page: installing, using and making skills, and the ten in this kit.
